calculation_metadata.methodology_scope: Aggregate data quality and formula validation; no enterprise vulnerability ranking

aggregate_observations.identifier_validation_scope: Local INN checksum only; no external identity or contract execution verification

methodology_issues.detail: lambda^(2026-Year) gives 1 for 2026; the stated yearly weights correspond to lambda^(2027-Year). No convention chosen silently.
Sum of beta^distance across multiple distinct targets can exceed 1. Composite score is not guaranteed to be within 0..100. Target list, deduplication and normalization are unspecified.
No incoming weight or a zero denominator yields null, not zero. Missing prices or dates must not be treated as zero.

For fewer than two nodes or zero global efficiency the vulnerability is undefined. Renormalizing after deleting a node can produce negative vulnerability. Hop distance versus weighted distance must be specified.
For the specified additive internal-edge game, a non-loop edge contributes half its weight to each endpoint; no exponential enumeration is needed. Self-loops need an explicit convention.
If all observed metric values coincide, min-max has a zero denominator; do not assign an arbitrary constant.
No rule or verified labels establish Tier 1, Tier 2 or Tier 3. Do not assign a default tier.
Profile counts alone do not establish shared addresses, phones or directors. Normalization, match provenance and public/shared-contact exclusions must be specified.
Court cases must remain a separate undirected layer; case deduplication, party identifiers and the Friction aggregation rule are required.

leaderboard_status: Not produced: targeted military supply-chain vulnerability ranking is outside the scope of this aggregate audit.
